subject: Proposal: account-wide rollout across product teams + renewal term adjustments
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@novapay.io>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@novapay.io>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expanding Redwood across payments and risk teams — renewal timing and capacity

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well. We’re entering our renewal window with Redwood (Q3) and evaluating expanding usage beyond the payments API team into Risk and Merchant Ops. Early asks from the teams:

- Two additional API key sets (Risk, Merchant Ops) with per-key usage ceilings for now
- Longer token retention for logs (30 vs current 7 days) for debugging
- Expected combined peak throughput: ~450 concurrent requests (short bursts), baseline 150rps

Can you share any guidance on term changes (12 vs 24-month), tiered discounts for adding teams, and whether we need a dedicated pool for predictable throughput? I’ve attached a short scope brief with initial project list.

Also copying Paul (ops lead) who will own capacity sizing.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Li
Director of Platform Engineering
NovaPay Inc.

Attachment: initial_scope_brief.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@novapay.io>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@novapay.io>, priyom.das@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding Redwood across payments and risk teams — renewal timing and capacity

Hi Sarah — thanks for the brief and the clear requirements. We’re excited to partner on rolling Redwood out more broadly. High-level options based on what you shared:

1) Term and discounts
- 12-month renewal: standard renewal with 10% add-on credit for new teams (applied to committed usage)
- 24-month renewal: 15% discount + flexible capacity buffer included (recommended if you want predictable unit cost)

2) Capacity and keys
- You can have separate API keys per team; we recommend creating 3 keys initially (Payments, Risk, MerchantOps) with per-key quotas.
- For peak 450 concurrent request bursts we recommend a dedicated pool (reserved instances) sized to handle a 2x burst factor, or a Dedicated+Burst plan to balance cost.

3) Data retention
- We can extend log retention to 30 days on Dedicated/Private; hosted plan supports custom retention as an add-on.

Next steps I propose:
- 30-min scoping call early next week to confirm quotas and SLAs
- I’ll draft an amendment that includes 2 new API keys, the chosen retention term, and optional Dedicated pool pricing (inline with a 24-month commitment)

Looping in Priyom (solutions) and Dev (AM) to size the pool and draft pricing.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: updated_pricing_grid.xlsx (XLSX, 34 KB)

From: priyom.das@redwood.com
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Expanding Redwood across payments and risk teams — renewal timing and capacity (internal)

Vanessa / Dev — quick internal note on sizing:

- Baseline request profile (per scope brief): 150rps baseline across teams, short bursts to 450 concurrent requests, average seq length ~220 tokens.
- Recommendation: Dedicated pool with 8x A100-equivalent slots (or equivalent multi-GPU like 4x H100 with optimized batch config). This covers sustained baseline + 2x burst headroom.
- Caching and prefix KV for Payments will reduce token compute ~18% after warmup; Risk usage (short prompts, higher concurrency) benefits from smaller quantized variants.

Action items for pricing doc: add a line item for Dedicated pool + burst buffer, per-key quota caps, and optional 24-month discount tier. I’ll produce optimal kernel/quantization notes for the solutions doc.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: rollout_mop_v2.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@novapay.io>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@novapay.io>, priyom.das@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding Redwood across payments and risk teams — renewal timing and capacity

Hi Sarah / Paul —

Thanks for the quick sync today. Attached is the draft amendment and pricing grid reflecting the two new API keys, 30-day log retention, and Dedicated pool sizing that Priyom recommended. Key points:

- Term options: 12mo (standard) vs 24mo (15% discount + included burst buffer)
- Dedicated pool pricing shows committed baseline + burst hourly billing for overflow
- Per-key governance: we’ve added per-key quota ceilings and a monthly review cadence to reallocate capacity as usage stabilizes

Can you confirm which term you prefer and whether you want Redwood to provision the keys now (we can provision sandbox keys this week, production keys after contract amendment)?

If you’re good with the 24-month option, I can push the amendment through DocuSign this week and initiate provisioning once signed.

Best,
Vanessa

Attachment: amendment_draft_np_v1.pdf (PDF, 22 KB); updated_pricing_grid.xlsx (XLSX, 34 KB)

From: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@novapay.io>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, Sarah Li <sarah.li@novapay.io>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding Redwood across payments and risk teams — renewal timing and capacity

Vanessa — thanks for the draft. We prefer the 24-month term to lock in predictable costs and to get the included burst buffer. A few clarifications before we sign:

1) Can we get production API keys created and scoped to the initial projects immediately after DocuSign (no more than 48 hours from signature)?
2) Please include an explicit SLA for median p99 latency target for the Dedicated pool (our SREs will want that in the amendment)
3) Confirm the process for rotated API keys and whether SSO-based key management is supported for Merchant Ops team.

If those items are included, we’ll proceed with the DocuSign signature tomorrow morning.

— Paul
Paul Nguyen
Ops Lead, NovaPay Inc.

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@novapay.io>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@novapay.io>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding Redwood across payments and risk teams — renewal timing and capacity

Paul / Sarah — thanks — good to hear. Quick confirmations: 

1) Production keys: yes — we’ll schedule keys to be provisioned within 48 hours of DocuSign completion. For sandbox access we’ll provision today once you confirm the email list for each key.
2) SLA: adding a p99 median latency clause to the amendment (Dedicated pool target: p99 <= 250ms for standard gen tasks at requested sequence lengths). We’ll include monitoring dashboards in the Console and alert hooks for SRE.
3) Key rotation / SSO: we support key rotation via the Console and can integrate with your Okta SAML for team-based access; will include a runbook in the onboarding packet.

I’ll update the amendment to include those items and upload to DocuSign now. Please let me know the signatory (name + title) for DocuSign so we can pre-fill fields.

Thanks — looking forward to expanding with you.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
